answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a beacon pairs each agent with an auditor from a grove of established agents, judging from its own knoll; the auditor re-checks one work proof and publishes a verdict. Failure burns half the 40 POA bond, a second failure burns it all and expels the identity, and a covering-up auditor loses its own bond, held as a copper token. So 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 POA and risk losing it all, while an honest agent pays one bond and earns undiluted.
